# watchpoint_vault_secret (Data Source)

Looks up a single vault secret by key within the tenant. Exposes metadata only; the secret value is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_vault_secret" "example" {
  key = "PAYMENTS_API_KEY"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the vault secret to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) Grouping category: `credential`, `token`, `certificate`, or `other`.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) Vault secret ID.
